_description: Known bloatware startup programs. StartupManager flags these for easy identification.

entries.name: OneDrive
entries.description: Cloud storage sync client. Safe to disable if you don't use OneDrive.

entries.name: Microsoft Teams
entries.description: Communication app. Adds 3-5 seconds to boot time. Safe to disable and launch manually.

entries.name: Cortana
entries.description: Voice assistant. Runs in background consuming memory. Safe to disable.

entries.name: Microsoft Edge Startup Boost
entries.description: Pre-launches Edge processes at startup for faster opening. Uses 100-200MB RAM.

entries.name: Xbox Game Bar
entries.description: Gaming overlay. Uses background resources even when not gaming. Safe to disable.

entries.name: Spotify
entries.description: Music streaming. Launches at startup to reduce open time. Safe to disable.

entries.name: Discord
entries.description: Chat application. Auto-starts for notifications. Safe to disable and launch manually.

entries.name: Skype
entries.description: Legacy communication app. Uses resources in background. Safe to disable.

entries.name: Adobe Creative Cloud
entries.description: Adobe license manager and sync. Uses 200-400MB RAM. Safe to disable if not actively syncing.

entries.name: iTunes Helper
entries.description: Auto-detects iOS devices. Safe to disable if not syncing Apple devices regularly.

entries.name: Steam Client Bootstrapper
entries.description: Gaming platform. Auto-starts for update checks. Safe to disable and launch manually.

entries.name: Epic Games Launcher
entries.description: Gaming platform. Runs background processes for updates. Safe to disable.

entries.name: Zoom
entries.description: Video conferencing. Auto-starts for meeting join speed. Safe to disable.

entries.name: Google Drive
entries.description: Cloud storage sync. Safe to disable if not actively syncing.

entries.name: Dropbox
entries.description: Cloud storage sync. Uses background resources. Safe to disable if not syncing.
